about.reminder1_text_a: You have watched {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} here. TMPlayer has no ads of its own and no account of ours. If it earns a spot on your screen, a coffee keeps it going. It is voluntary and unlocks nothing.
about.reminder1_text_b: That is {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}} finished in TMPlayer. It has no ads of its own and costs nothing. If it was worth your time, a coffee keeps it going. It is voluntary and unlocks nothing.
about.reminder1_title_b: A small thank you, if you like
about.reminder2_text_a: A star on GitHub, or a word to a friend, helps more people find TMPlayer and costs nothing. If you would rather chip in, Settings has that too.
about.reminder2_text_b: Telling a friend or starring the project on GitHub is the cheapest way to help. Chipping in is always in Settings, and never required.
about.reminder2_title_b: Know someone who would like this?
about.reminder3_text_a: This is the last time TMPlayer will ask. If it has earned a coffee, the link is here. Either way it stays free, with every feature for everyone.
about.reminder3_text_b: This is the final reminder. If you would like to chip in you can, and Settings keeps the link. If not, nothing changes.
